# **1\. Interface Draft and Screen Inventory**

| Surface | Purpose and current form |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Opening and briefing** | Start or resume one shift; explain role, five dossiers, Capacity-only scope, fixed room, and assumptions. |
| **Candidate desk** | Select five dossiers in any order, with status and persistent total, approved, and remaining room. |
| **Dossier workspace** | Read neutral profile, income, costs, obligations, request, metrics, and the decision panel. |
| **Supporting document** | Read-only modal with paper evidence; no result or risk verdict before lock. |
| **Adjust terms** | Amount and tenor controls within the decision panel, with installment and room preview. |
| **Confirmation** | Separate modal for irreversible Confirm & lock case after Review decision. |
| **Consequence and scorecard** | Post-lock explanation and five-case portfolio summary; completed cases stay read-only. |

 

There are **9 desktop visual states**, implemented as pages, panels, or dialogs rather than separate routes. The style uses **cold pixel-art, charcoal terminal, paper textures, square controls, and restrained neon**. Typography is split by purpose: **Press Start 2P** for short display text, **VT323** for terminal labels, **Be Vietnam Pro** for readable text/names, and **JetBrains Mono** for financial values. All UI copies are in English.

Desktop keeps the **room HUD, applicant navigation, dossier, and decision pane**, while mobile switches to a single-column layout. Accessibility targets include **16px+ body text, 4.5:1 contrast, 44px touch targets, visible focus, text \+ color states**, and reduced motion without losing information.
